TanStack Router code-based root route.description:
Declare the root route of a code-based route tree, for projects that do not run the route generator. Requires createRootRoute and Outlet from @tanstack/react-router.

为不运行路由生成器的工程声明代码式路由树的根路由；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRootRoute 与 Outlet。

TanStack Router code-based route.description:
Declare a route in a code-based route tree and attach it to its parent. Requires createRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

在代码式路由树中声明路由并挂到父路由；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRoute。

TanStack Router code-based route tree.description:
Assemble a code-based route tree; the result is passed to createRouter as routeTree. Requires routes created with createRoute.

组装代码式路由树，结果作为 routeTree 传给 createRouter；需要用 createRoute 创建的路由。

TanStack Router code-based lazy route.description:
Split a code-based route so its component loads on demand; the lazy module exports a Route made with createLazyRoute. Requires createRoute from @tanstack/react-router.

拆分代码式路由使其组件按需加载，lazy 模块导出由 createLazyRoute 创建的 Route；需要 @tanstack/react-router 的 createRoute。
